content.short: The world's first Multi-Token ISPO is live! Stake ADA and receive five tokens ($SMART, $LTY, $HYN, $REACH and $DG)
content.description: About Multi-Token ISPO An ISPO, or Initial Stake Pool Offering, is a permissionless, community-funding method unique to Cardano that allows anyone to support promising early-stage startups. Many people involved in crypto are interested in getting the tokens of multiple projects. Unfortunately, most people delegate to one ISPO at a time. The Multi-Token ISPO by Genius X is a solution for giving the community access to multiple projects simultaneously. Delegators will get the tokens of five projects by delegating their ADA to a single ISPO.
content.meta: Find out about Multi-Token ISPO by Genius X (ISPO) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment.
